source.directorySummary: Implements the bottomup.enrich pipeline that enriches stored source-grounded directory and file summaries with AI-generated architectural roles via coverage and compact-summary validation, parent context propagation, per-directory prompt invocation with input-hash caching, and plan/draft/revise/accept orchestration exposed through CLI and web adapters.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Provides CLI/web adapters that map parsed options via stringOrNull/boolToOverride parsing into executeBottomupEnrich, reviseBottomupEnrichDraft, and acceptBottomupEnrichDraft calls with web draft rendering.

ai.ts.sourceSummary: Implements runEnrichAgent to build a JSON-only enrichment prompt from directory source/compact summaries, file summaries, child summaries and effective context and parses the fenced JSON output via EnrichAiResponseSchema using GeneratePrompt.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines SubcommandDefinitions for bottomup.enrich and hidden bottomup.enrich.revise/accept with flags for path, root, context, prompt, model, filtering, draft, plan, and allow-partial.

handler.test.ts.sourceSummary: Tests bottomup.enrich registration, summary-only prompting without raw source, coverage validation, allow-partial handling, web draft creation/acceptance, planning, and hash-based skip behavior.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Orchestrates enrichment by collecting candidates, validating current source coverage, propagating effective parent context, invoking per-directory AI enrichment with input-hash caching, and handling plan/draft/accept flows.

types.ts.sourceSummary: Defines Zod schemas and types for EnrichAiResponse, resolved options, candidates, plans, draft state, and written/plan/draft result variants.

summary.value: Implements the `bottomup.enrich` pipeline to enrich stored source-grounded directory/file summaries with AI-generated architectural roles — validating coverage/compact-summary, propagating parent context, invoking per-directory prompts with input-hash caching, and orchestrating plan/draft/revise/accept via CLI and web adapters. Child `renderers` renders enrichment drafts as a modal web UI presenting the diff patch with revise and accept/decline actions.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Human-in-the-loop augmentation stage of the bottom-up knowledge pipeline under the file plugin's commands aggregation. Unlike sibling file/git commands that validate containment and execute filesystem operations directly, this directory operates purely on already-persisted source-grounded summaries produced upstream — adding parent-context-aware architectural interpretation for downstream summary/index consumers. It depends on the parent's effective-context propagation and pairs its handler-orchestrated hash-cache/plan-draft lifecycle with the renderers child to provide modal review, sharing CLI/web adapter and filtering conventions with generate/summarize/summary but owning no filesystem or git logic itself.

files.adapter.ts: Transport boundary for the enrich pipeline — translates CLI args and web form options (via stringOrNull/boolToOverride) into typed handler calls for execute/revise/accept and delegates draft rendering to renderers. Mirrors the CLI/web dual-adapter pattern of sibling bottomup commands but is the only adapter to expose three lifecycle entry points.
files.ai.ts: Prompt-construction and response-validation seam — assembles the JSON-only enrichment prompt from handler-supplied source/compact/file/child/effective-context and parses fenced JSON via EnrichAiResponseSchema through the shared GeneratePrompt utility. Isolates AI contract concerns from handler orchestration and caching.
files.definition.ts: Declarative command contract — registers the user-visible bottomup.enrich subcommand and hidden bottomup.enrich.revise/accept companions that together realize the plan/draft/accept lifecycle. Shares filtering, prompt/model, and workspace-root flags with sibling bottomup definitions.
files.handler.test.ts: Invariant verification for summary-only enrichment — guards that prompts use stored summaries not raw source, and that coverage validation, allow-partial, draft creation/acceptance, planning, and input-hash skip behave correctly. No production logic; ensures handler/renderers contract stability.
files.handler.ts: Orchestration core — owns candidate collection, current source-coverage and compact-summary validation, effective parent-context propagation, per-directory input-hash-cached AI invocation via ai.ts, and plan/draft/accept state persistence. Coordinator that adapter and renderers delegate to.
files.types.ts: Shared contract definitions — Zod schemas and types for EnrichAiResponse, resolved options, candidates, plans, draft state, and written/plan/draft result variants that type-check the adapter → handler → ai → renderers flow.
